负记录 hard 5s 就每 5s 回源吗？Does five-second hard age mean one fetch per five seconds?
不是。本例 L2 扣2s，只复用不足3s，100个重复key理想约33.3次/s；20忽略所有余量。发送再扣1s，端到端频率依赖刷新/验证策略。No. L2 subtracts 2s, reusing under 3s: 100 repeated keys ideally cost about 33.3/s; 20 ignores all margins. Sending subtracts another 1s, and end-to-end rates depend on refresh/validation.
